title: My Son Forged A Gift Letter, Sold My Business For $1.6M. So I Watched Him Wear The Helmet.
description: After my son forged a gift letter and sold my electric bike business for $1.6M, he thought I’d stay silent. I proved the forgery, reclaimed the IP, and built 'Mama's Revenge Rides' into a $2M company. Now he works for me as a delivery driver, wearing a helmet that reads 'Perjurer on Probation' every shift. #FamilyBetrayal #JusticeServed #MamasRevengeRides
thumb_text: HE THOUGHT HE STOLE $1.6M. NOW HE WEARS THE HELMET.
pinned_comment: If your own son forged a gift letter and sent you a $200 gift card after selling your business behind your back, would you have made him deliver your bikes wearing a 'Perjurer on Probation' helmet? Share your story below!
